name: pbi-autobuilder
description: Local web app that turns raw data + a project brief into a ready-to-open Power BI project (cleaning, model, DAX, dashboard).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
